text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Observed spike in 5xx errors for /v1/paging during canary rollout of sdk@3.14. Canary cohort=3, error rate ~7% over last 5m, symptom: non-zero offset behavior (clients receiving offsets that skip items).

maya (oncall): seeing dashboards. paging latency ok but errors cluster at offset decode. any recent schema/enum changes?

lisa (sdk): pushed 3.14 earlier with an offset-encoding change (compact varint -> base64wrap) to reduce payload size. We tested, but maybe older clients hitting new serialization.

sam (eng): that sounds like a contract break. Are canary clients supposed to be pinned? Which routing policy allowed older clients to hit canary?

yonas (sre): traffic routing used rollout: 10% canary, but smart-routing fallback allowed cross-version hits for region eu-west-1. We're seeing older clients from a major customer (acct: AcmeCorp) in that region.

maya (oncall): impact: AcmeCorp reported duplicates/skips in their result pages, not total outage but incorrect pagination. CS triage says potential data loss for user-facing lists. Please escalate.

lisa (sdk): immediate mitigation: flip feature flag 'sdk_offset_v2' off for all cohorts. I can flip kill-switch via console. Would prefer kill-switch before rollback to stop new clients from hitting changed encoding.

deploy-bot: Automated canary monitor: rollback threshold breached for metric=paging_5xx (threshold=3%, current=7%). Initiating alerting workflow.

maya (oncall): lisa, execute kill-switch and pause the rollout. Also notify deploy team to halt further promotion.

lisa (sdk): executing now. command:
```
# disable flag for all cohorts
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  https://ops.redwood.ai/featureflags/sdk_offset_v2/disable \
  -d '{"scope":"global","actor":"sdk-team"}'
```

lisa (sdk): :white_check_mark: flag disabled. Confirmed no new canary users are assigned sdk@3.14 offsets encoding.

sam (eng): good. next step: rollback the canary build to 3.13 for the canary hosts. yonas, can you coordinate the rollback and ensure sticky routing for existing sessions?

yonas (sre): starting rollback playbook:
1) pause canary promotion
2) deploy previous image tag: nginx+inference-proxy:v3.13-canary
3) drain canary nodes gracefully (30s)
4) verify no 500s

yonas (sre): running:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/canary-proxy proxy=registry/redwood/proxy:v3.13-canary && kubectl rollout status deploy/canary-proxy -w
```

maya (oncall): CS notify: let customers know we paused rollout and are rolling back; ask AcmeCorp for request ids if they have examples. cs-ops: can you prepare template?

cs-ops: drafting now. include: impact, mitigation steps, ETA for fix (TBD until post-mortem). Will send to AcmeCorp + other customers with >1% usage of paging.

lisa (sdk): root cause hypothesis: the offset serialization change wasn't backward compatible; server accepted new encoding but older clients attempted to decode as varint and produced bad offsets. We'll ship a patch to make server accept both encodings (graceful decode) and add a handshake field in the protocol to negotiate encoding.

sam (eng): add automated contract tests to CI to prevent accepting non-negotiated encodings. Also need canary routing rule change so only clients with header `X-SDK-Version: 3.14` hit canary.

yonas (sre): rollback progressing, currently 40% of canary pods at v3.13, error rate already dropping to 2.1% in eu-west-1.

deploy-bot: :gear: Canary promotion paused by maya (oncall). Kill-switch active. Rollback in progress.

maya (oncall): action items (short):
- [x] kill-switch toggled (lisa)
- [x] pause rollout (maya)
- [x] rollback start (yonas)
- [ ] patch server to accept both encodings + handshake (lisa)
- [ ] add header-based canary routing (sam)
- [ ] CS customer notifications (cs-ops)

lisa (sdk): prepping patch branch now. Quick compatibility shim to attempt base64wrap decode first, fallback to varint. Will open PR and request urgent review.

sam (eng): also add smoke test hitting /v1/paging with mixed encodings. If you'll stagerun, I'll add to canary pipeline.

cs-ops: sent initial notification to AcmeCorp support alias: "We've paused a canary rollout affecting paging offsets; we suspect non-critical incorrect pagination for some calls. Mitigation in progress; we'll follow up with examples and ETA."

maya (oncall): update: last_message_ts=2461234899 - please add any customer-specific notes here. We'll keep this thread as the canonical incident chat and create a postmortem ticket after stabilizing.

lisa (sdk): PR opened: #5947 - compatibility shim + handshake header. Marked urgent, requesting 2-hr review.

yonas (sre): rollback complete at 2461234780, global error rate returned to baseline ~0.3% by 2461234860. Monitoring for regressions for next 2 hours.

maya (oncall): thanks team. once patch validated in staging and we have header-based routing we'll attempt a controlled canary re-roll with stricter client header gating. Postmortem owners: lisa (sdk), yonas (sre), sam (eng).

sam (eng): filed postmortem ticket PM-8891, assigned. I'll add CI gating and routing changes to the rollout checklist.

cs-ops: will follow up with customers after postmortem.

maya (oncall): closing incident channel for active work - keep @here for any alerts. If new regressions occur, reopen. :thumbsup:
